'''Restria Venteger''' was a member of the [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] [[Exex]], and [[Governor/Legends|governor]] [[Henris Octavian]]'s chief [[Aide/Legends|aide]]. Venteger wanted the city's [[central computer]] back on line in the wake of the [[Occupation of Bespin|occupation]] of Cloud City to protect secrets pertaining to [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]]. Venteger was also working with [[Braka]], an [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] tribal guild leader who was organizing a [[Miner/Legends|miner's]] strike to embarrass the new governor.<ref name="Game" />
